notes: The grid shows the left 2 m as sky/neighbour, while photo 3 puts the left bay at the corner. The bays and windows are placed between the grid and photo 3, leaning to the grid, which agrees with the right corner. The diner glazing layout under its sign is approximate. The billboard is modelled as a plain board with no lettering. The Amro corner canopy sign mostly runs off this wall and is omitted. | The grid read about 0.8-1 m too far right on this wall. Modules were placed from the photographs: the fire-escape door and the arch share a centre at about 9.65 m. The canted bay groups sit at 1.8-5.1 m and 12.0-15.5 m, with a 10.2 m period. Amro's fascia runs to the arch surround. The cafe front is at 12.0-14.9 m, then a gated glazed door with a tile surround at 15.1-16.6 m. The First Cup blade sits at the corner with the neighbour building. Only the top-floor landing area of the fire escape was hard to see. The Coca-Cola pole sign is at the corner and was left out. Height is taken from the L
